# VM Monitoring

Comprehensive virtual machine health: CPU, memory, and disk utilization, heartbeat status, top processes, and OS-level error logs for Windows and Linux.

content.query:
// VM heartbeat health – last heartbeat per VM, flag stale agents
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId
| extend
    MinutesSinceHeartbeat = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat),
    Status = case(
        LastHeartbeat >= ago(5m),  'Healthy',
        LastHeartbeat >= ago(30m), 'Degraded',
        'Offline'
    )
| order by MinutesSinceHeartbeat desc
| project Computer, OSType, ResourceGroup, LastHeartbeat, MinutesSinceHeartbeat, Status
content.title: VM Heartbeat Health
CPU Usage Trend per VM

content.query:
// Memory utilization per VM – % Committed Bytes In Use
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == '% Committed Bytes In Use'
| summarize
    AvgMemoryPct = round(avg(CounterValue), 2),
    MaxMemoryPct = round(max(CounterValue), 2),
    P95MemoryPct = round(percentile(CounterValue, 95), 2)
    by Computer
| order by AvgMemoryPct desc
| project Computer, AvgMemoryPct, P95MemoryPct, MaxMemoryPct
content.title: Memory Utilization per VM (% Committed Bytes In Use)

content.query:
// Disk free space warnings – volumes below 15%
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'LogicalDisk' and CounterName == '% Free Space'
| where InstanceName !in ('_Total', 'HarddiskVolume1')
| summarize AvgFreeSpacePct = round(avg(CounterValue), 2), LatestFreeSpacePct = round(arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue).CounterValue, 2) by Computer, InstanceName
| where AvgFreeSpacePct < 15
| order by AvgFreeSpacePct asc
| project Computer, Drive = InstanceName, AvgFreeSpacePct, LatestFreeSpacePct
content.title: Disk Free Space Warnings (< 15%)

content.query:
// Top processes by CPU from VM Insights metrics
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage'
| extend ComputerName = tostring(split(_ResourceId, '/')[-1])
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 2) by ComputerName, Tags
| extend Process = extract(@'"vm.azm.ms/processName":"([^"]+)"', 1, tostring(Tags))
| where isnotempty(Process)
| top 20 by AvgCPU desc
| project ComputerName, Process, AvgCPU
content.title: Top 20 Processes by CPU Usage

content.query:
// Windows Event Log errors – top error sources
Event
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where EventLevelName == 'Error'
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by Source, EventID, Computer
| top 25 by ErrorCount desc
| project Computer, Source, EventID, ErrorCount
content.title: Windows Event Log Errors

content.query:
// Syslog errors for Linux VMs
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where SeverityLevel in ('err', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg')
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by Computer, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName
| top 25 by ErrorCount desc
| project Computer, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, ErrorCount
content.title: Linux Syslog Errors
